# Knowledge Graphs & GraphRAG

**Store facts as connected entities, query them with Cypher, build graphs from text with LLMs, and use them for retrieval that follows relationships.**

Level: **Intermediate** · 13 steps · 4h 27m of video · Prerequisites: [AI Engineering](ai-engineering.md) (embeddings and RAG). [Graph Neural Networks](graph-neural-networks.md) helps for the embeddings step but is optional.

[Track your progress on the website](https://gruheshkurra.github.io/awesome-ai-roadmaps/knowledge-graphs-and-graphrag/) · [All roadmaps](../README.md)

## Build it

- Extract a knowledge graph from 20 Wikipedia articles with an LLM, load it into Neo4j, and answer five multi-hop questions with Cypher.
- Build plain vector RAG and GraphRAG over the same documents and compare their answers on 10 questions that need connected facts.
- Index a small corpus with LightRAG and write up its indexing cost, speed, and answer quality next to Microsoft GraphRAG.
